title: `nvs check` on a file a program autoloads or requires checks it through that program's `autoload` map
scope:
what `nvs check <file>` resolves a file's names through when the file declares no `autoload` of
its own, which tree it searches for the program that lends one, and when it searches at all. Which
program lends, and what a borrowed declaration may report, are [0198](0198.md)'s and unchanged.
validatedBy:
`crates/nvs-cli/tests/check_borrow.rs`, the language server's `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/autoload.rs`,
and the run under *Verification*.
